description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least seven mana of any color
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

uses.name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

uses.name: Singing Bell Strike
uses.cardState: attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes
